Task: Match a simple email address: non-space non-@ characters, an @, more such characters, a dot, then more.

Write a pattern that matches exactly the strings that should match.

turns.thinking: The pattern text does not change at all; what changes is how it is applied. IGNORECASE makes the literal domain match in any letter case. Pattern: [^\s@]+@example\.com
